# Synthetic historical-data fixtures

These are retained MES regression fixtures, not an active futures market choice. NVDA/Alpaca fixture and admission work is planned in [NVDA_DATA_PLAN.md](../../../docs/data/NVDA_DATA_PLAN.md) and remains unimplemented.

Fixtures are generated by `quantlab.data.synthetic` inside temporary test directories. No vendor payload, credentials or real market data is committed.

The small encoder follows Databento's public DBN metadata and record layout; tests feed its compressed bytes to the **independent installed Nautilus decoder**. Definitions use DBN v1, bars use DBN v2. Public layout references: [metadata encoder](https://github.com/databento/dbn/blob/main/rust/dbn/src/encode/dbn/sync.rs), [v1 definition layout](https://github.com/databento/dbn/blob/main/rust/dbn/src/compat.rs). The production pipeline uses Nautilus to decode definitions/prices, with additional raw framing/identity/tick checks.

The default demo creates fixed prices around 5000, volume 10, provider instrument ID 123, MESZ2 with explicitly supplied contract dates and a November 2022 calendar scenario. Cash holiday/early-close examples exercise November 24/25 and the following session. CME intervals are explicit **synthetic test controls**, not an authoritative historical exchange calendar. The March fixture uses distinct H22/M22 prices (4000/5000), IDs and expiries across DST and the chosen Monday roll; it proves that contract prices are not stitched or substituted. A separate November 3–9 scenario verifies the fall DST change and the preceding Friday's distinct UTC offset through native storage/replay.

Additional tests construct missing, duplicate, reversed, conflicting, off-tick, truncated, unknown-ID, zero-volume and out-of-bounds records, plus a deliberately fictional December Monday closure to test next-full-session roll behavior. These cases are labeled synthetic and establish implementation behavior only. They cannot prove real vendor coverage, price accuracy, liquidity, licensing, latency, fills or financial performance.
